```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```


### STAR alignment


#### Percentage of mapped reads:
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=F}

samples <- list.files("../04_mapping/")
files <- list.files(path=paste0("../04_mapping/", samples), pattern = "*.*final.out")

dat <- paste0("../04_mapping/",samples, "/", files) %>%
  lapply(., read.table, header = F, sep="\t", fill=T) %>%
  Map(cbind, ., sample = samples) %>%
  do.call(rbind.data.frame, .) %>%
  mutate(V1 = gsub("^\\s*| \\|", "", V1))


## plotting
datplot <- dat %>%
  filter(V1 %in% c("Uniquely mapped reads %", "% of reads mapped to multiple loci", "% of reads unmapped: too many mismatches",
                   "% of reads mapped to too many loci", "% of reads unmapped: too short")) %>%
  mutate(V2 = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", V2)),
         V1 = gsub("% of reads unmapped: too many mismatches", "% of reads unmapped:\ntoo many mismatches", V1),
         V1 = gsub("Uniquely mapped reads %", "% uniquely mapped reads", V1),
         V1 = factor(V1, c("% uniquely mapped reads", "% of reads mapped to multiple loci", "% of reads unmapped:\ntoo many mismatches",
                   "% of reads mapped to too many loci", "% of reads unmapped: too short"), ordered=T))


data <- datplot %>% filter(V1=="% uniquely mapped reads")


tab <- datplot %>%
  group_by(V1) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(V2), Median=median(V2),Min=min(V2), Max=max(V2)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Type=V1) %>%
  mutate(Type = gsub("% of reads unmapped:\ntoo many mismatches", "% of reads unmapped: too many mismatches", Type))


tab %>%
  kbl() %>%
  kable_styling()


ggplot(datplot, aes(x=V2, fill=V1)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha=.7, show.legend = F, bins=15, col="black") +
  facet_wrap(.~V1) +
  theme_light() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black')) +
  expand_limits(x = c(0, 100))
```



#### Origin of reads and bias
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=F}
dat <- paste0("../06_qualimap/", samples, "/", "rnaseq_qc_results.edit.txt") %>%
  lapply(., read.table, header = F, sep="\t", fill=T, quote="") %>%
  Map(cbind, ., sample = samples) %>%
  do.call(rbind.data.frame, .) %>%
  mutate(V2 = gsub(".*\\(|\\)|%", "", V2),
         V2 = as.numeric(V2))

tab <- dat %>%
  group_by(V1) %>%
  summarise(Mean = round(mean(V2),2), Median=median(V2),Min=min(V2), Max=max(V2)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Type=V1) %>%
  arrange(match(Type, c("exonic", "overlapping exon", "intronic", "intergenic", "3' bias", "5' bias", "5'-3' bias")))

tab$Type[1:4] <- paste("%", tab$Type[1:4], sep=" ")




kbl(tab[1:7,]) %>%
kable_styling(full_width = T) %>%
  row_spec(1, background = "seagreen") %>%
  row_spec(7, background = "seagreen")

```
